literalSourceCompetence: Relate the two-dimensional wave-function representations of H atoms/H2 to spatial probability densities.
Infer existence of simple diatomic second-period molecules or molecular ions from the corresponding energy-level schemes.
literalLB4ModelContents: LCAO, orbital conservation, bonding and antibonding molecular orbitals.
Sigma/pi orbital formation and simple-molecule energy-level diagrams, including HOMO/LUMO.
N2 and O2 occur as explicitly offered examples for diatomic bonding; these examples are selectable, not a requirement to cover every named species.
MO.inferredOperationalization: For a supplied, appropriately labelled MO energy diagram, count electrons occupying bonding and antibonding orbitals and calculate (N_bonding − N_antibonding)/2. This quantifies the net bonding of the expressly prescribed model and makes the same diagram interpretation/existence inference observable. It adds no molecular family, unrelated model or independent comparative-stability topic. The term/formula is didactic operationalization, not an official-source quotation.
MO.independentChemicalCheck: Using valence-only diagrams, O2 has eight bonding and four antibonding electrons, giving bond order 2; N2 has eight bonding and two antibonding electrons, giving 3. Including equally occupied core bonding/antibonding orbitals leaves those values unchanged. Correct diagram-specific sigma/pi ordering and electron occupancy are required; positive formal bond order is a result within this simplified model, not an unconditional general stability theorem.
MO.wholeSourceOperatorAndCoupledContextAsse: The retained c0 cluster states both complete literal operators. Its fbc5a920 child covers wave functions/probability density and its 386e28af child covers molecular existence from energy schemes. Adding f85 does not replace or erase either. The adjacent 70bcb6bd LCAO explanation remains a distinct goal; f85 only interprets supplied schemes and quantitatively expresses net bonding. Both native gA and eA source occurrences remain intact. No prerequisite, broad mapping union or cluster inheritance is used to fill f85 itself.
MO.laterAdoptionLimits: Root must adopt exactly against these CAS bytes and separately check current projections, all affected source/context tuples and ordinary gates. This source review does not alter the earlier sealed D source-hold judgment or attest D/P/A/M/V completion.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Carbonsäure-Derivate vergleichen
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann die Reaktivität von Carbonsäurechloriden, Carbonsäureanhydriden und Carbonsäureestern bei vergleichbaren nucleophilen Acylsubstitutionen ordnen und die Unterschiede anhand von Carbonylgruppe und Abgangsgruppe begründen.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can rank the reactivity of carboxylic acid chlorides, carboxylic acid anhydrides, and carboxylic esters in comparable nucleophilic acyl substitutions and justify the differences using the carbonyl group and leaving group.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Carbonsäure-Derivate vergleichen
resourceLinks.altText: Comicartige Strukturübersicht eines vergleichbaren nucleophilen Acylsubstitutionsfalls: Carbonsäurechlorid, Carbonsäureanhydrid und Carbonsäureester werden anhand ihrer Carbonyl- und Abgangsgruppen verglichen. Die schematische Rangfolge betrifft diese vergleichbaren Fälle, keine beliebigen Chloride oder universelle Geschwindigkeit unter unterschiedlichen Bedingungen.
